description: **Route completions through the lifecycle guard.** Audit finding: the guard had never guarded a real feature — 321 managed features, 31 registered guard resources, ZERO overlap (all 31 are leaked test fixtures), 230 COMPLETE features none of which passed a guarded transition. `COMP-MCP-ENFORCE/report.md:8,52` claims "no caller can effect an unverified transition"; that has always been false (AC-14, still outstanding). Cause: the writers that actually complete features never call a guarded transition at all — registration was always possible (`guardedTransition` registers lazily), it simply never happened. Design rev 6 after five Codex rounds (8→8→7→7→7 findings, flat — the pre-registered stopping criterion fired, so the work was sliced instead of reviewed harder). Slice 1 SHIPPED @753ed47: `lib/completion-gate.js` gates `record_completion` (MCP + CLI) — evidence verification, write-ahead intent, guarded transition; `roadmap add --status COMPLETE` refused; `--tests-pass` default removed (BREAKING). Slice 2 SHIPPED @4625b2b: the build runner. Exactly one completion, at terminalization, AFTER the health gate — previously the terminal block wrote COMPLETE before the health gate that can fail the build, and ship had already written a second record. Tests hoisted above the non-git branch (which returned before running them and hard-coded tests_pass:true); `deriveTestsAttested` tri-state; accumulator v1→v2 with `tests_attested`/`evidence_root`. Slice 3 REMAINING: gate owns the projections (§2.3a) + `VisionWriter.completeItem` + self-verifying projection endpoint + three verification tiers (§2.3b), refusals on paths 5/7/8/14 (`setFeatureStatus`, vision PATCH, stratum-sync, direct `updateItemStatus`), `roadmap migrate` exemption (AC-17), AC-19 allowlist test, AC-14 report correction. Deferred: paths 9/15 → COMP-COMPLETION-GATE-REMOTE; fix/plan modes → COMP-COMPLETION-GATE-MODES. NOT to be described as "completions are guarded" until slice 3 lands.
